case.summary: This case was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.90 for an online transaction of $99.92 on card C07987-K2. The graph and case-memory analysis showed that the rare device profile was shared across five distinct cards in a tight six-day window with near-identical micro-amounts, indicating automated card-testing or a credential-stuffing script. The verdict was closed_fraud due to the high fraud probability of 0.99 and connection to a fraudulent device ring. Following the investigation, the card was blocked under policy 6, a case was created, a report was filed, and connected cards are being monitored.
